home.title: ghiberti85/ui
home.subtitle: Design systems & component library by Fernando Ghiberti
home.description: A collection of design systems and React components built for authorial projects. Multiple visual identities, one component API.

tokens.title: Design Tokens
tokens.subtitle: Three visual systems. One token format.
tokens.semantic_tokens_desc: How semantic color tokens resolve across each design system.

components.title: Components
components.subtitle: React component library built on design tokens.
components.button_desc: Interactive element with 4 variants and 4 sizes. Supports loading and disabled states.
components.badge_desc: Small pill-shaped label for status and metadata.
components.input_desc: Accessible text input with label, error, and disabled states.
components.input_error_msg: Please enter a valid email address.
components.card_description: A short description of the card content.
components.card_content: This is the card body. It can contain any content.
components.textarea_desc: Multi-line text input with optional label, helper text, and error state.
components.select_desc: Accessible dropdown built on Radix UI. Supports error and disabled states.
components.checkbox_desc: Accessible checkbox with checked, unchecked, and indeterminate states.
components.checkbox_checked_desc: You can change this in your account settings.
components.radio_desc: Accessible radio group for single-selection from a set of options.
components.radio_opt_email_desc: We'll send updates to your inbox.
components.radio_opt_phone_desc: We'll call you during business hours.
components.radio_opt_sms_desc: Short text messages to your mobile.
components.switch_desc: Toggle switch for boolean preferences. Supports label, description, and disabled.
components.switch_with_desc_desc: Enable experimental features. May be unstable.
components.dialog_desc: Modal dialog built on Radix UI with overlay, title, description, and action buttons.
components.dialog_description: Are you sure you want to proceed? This action cannot be undone.
components.separator_desc: Thin visual divider for separating content sections.
components.typography_desc: Heading, Text, Label, and Code components built on design token typography scales.
components.typography_text_xl: Text xl — Large body copy for introductions.
components.typography_text_lg: Text lg — Slightly larger body copy.
components.typography_text_md: Text md — Default body text for most content.
components.typography_text_sm: Text sm — Smaller helper or secondary text.
components.typography_text_xs: Text xs — Captions and fine print.
components.stack_desc: Flex container for composing vertical and horizontal layouts with gap control.
components.container_desc: Centered max-width wrapper. Available sizes: sm, md, lg, xl, full.
